arxiv-1705-02407.title: Knowledge-Guided Deep Fractal Neural Networks for Human Pose Estimation
arxiv-1705-02407.creator: Guanghan Ning, Zhi Zhang, and Zhihai He
arxiv-1705-02407.description: Abstract Human pose estimation using deep neural networks aims to map input images with large variations into multiple body keypoints which must satisfy a set of geometric constraints and inter-dependency imposed by the human body model. This is a very challenging nonlinear manifold learning process in a very high dimensional feature space.

arxiv-2009-06874.title: Recent scaling properties of Bitcoin price returns
arxiv-2009-06874.creator: T Takaishi
arxiv-2009-06874.description: Abstract While relevant stylized facts are observed for Bitcoin markets, we find a distinct property for the scaling behavior of the cumulative return distribution. For various assets, the tail index μ \mu of the cumulative return distribution exhibits μ ≈ 3 \mu\approx 3 , which is referred to as ”the inverse cubic law.

arxiv-2405-08065.title: Direct and Efficient Detection of Quantum Superposition
arxiv-2405-08065.creator: Daniel Kun, Teodor Strömberg, Michele Spagnolo, Borivoje Dakić, Lee A. Rozema, Philip Walther
arxiv-2405-08065.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Daniel Kun, Teodor Strömberg, Michele Spagnolo, Borivoje Dakić, Lee A. Rozema, Philip Walther. One of the most striking quantum phenomena is superposition, where one particle simultaneously inhabits different states. Most methods to verify coherent superposition are indirect, in that they require the distinct states to be recombined. Here, we adapt an XOR game, in which separated parties measure different parts of a superposed particle, and use it to verify superpositions with local measurements and a second independent particle.

arxiv-2509-05148.title: Bulk viscosity from early-time thermalization of cosmic fluids in light of DESI DR2 data
arxiv-2509-05148.creator: Hermano Velten, William Iania
arxiv-2509-05148.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Hermano Velten, William Iania. If nonrelativistic dark matter and radiation are allowed to interact, reaching an approximate thermal equilibrium, this interaction induces a bulk viscous pressure changing the effective one-fluid description of the universe dynamics. By modeling such components as perfect fluids, a cosmologically relevant bulk viscous pressure emerges for dark matter particle masses in the range of 1 ​ eV − 10 ​ eV 1\,\text{eV}-10\,\text{eV} keeping thermal equilibrium with the radiation.

arxiv-2511-08311.title: Coordinated Space- and Ground-based Monitoring of Accretion Bursts in a Protoplanetary Disk: The Orbital and Accretion Properties of DQ Tau Thanks: Based on observations collected at the European Organization for Astronomical Research in the Southern Hemisphere under ESO programs 114.2799.001, 114.2
arxiv-2511-08311.creator: Hala Alqubelat, Carlo F. Manara, Justyn Campbell-White, Monika G. Petr-Gotzens, Benjamin M. Tofflemire, Andrea Banzatti, Enrico Ragusa, Emma T. Whelan, Guillaume Bourdarot, Catherine Dougados, Eleonora Fiorellino, Sean I. Mills
arxiv-2511-08311.description: Abstract Multiplicity in pre-main-sequence (PMS) systems shapes circumstellar and circumbinary disks, often resulting in morphological features such as inner cavities, spiral arms, and gas streamers that facilitate mass transfer between the disk and stars. Consequently, accretion in eccentric close binaries is highly variable and synchronized with their orbits, producing distinct bursts near periastron passages.

pmc-10668679.title: Development of a New Marine Fish Continuous Cell Line Derived from Brain of Red Sea Bream (Pagrosomus major) and Its Application to Fish Virology and Heavy Metal Toxicology
pmc-10668679.creator: Xia Luo, Xiaozhe Fu, Min Zhang, Hongru Liang, Yinjie Niu, Qiang Lin, Baofu Ma, Lihui Liu, Ningqiu Li, Xiuzhen Sheng
pmc-10668679.description: Simple SummaryWith a mass production scale and important economic and nutritive value, red sea bream (Pagrosomus major) is one of the most popular farmed marine teleost fish species. However, outbreaks of diseases have produced huge losses to the aquaculture industry in recent years. Fish cell lines are suitable models to study fish physiology, virology, immunology and toxicology.

pmc-11545537.title: Fecal Microbiome Composition Correlates with Pathologic Complete Response in Patients with Operable Esophageal Cancer Treated with Combined Chemoradiotherapy and Immunotherapy
pmc-11545537.creator: Fyza Y Shaikh, Seoho Lee, James R White, Yujie Zhao, Jacqueline T Ferri, Gavin Pereira, Blair V Landon, Suqi Ke, Chen Hu, Josephine L Feliciano, Russell K Hales, K Ranh Voong, Richard J Battafarano, Stephen C Yang, Stephen Broderick, Jinny Ha, Elizabeth Thompson, Eun J Shin, David L Bartlett, Benny
pmc-11545537.description: Simple SummaryThis study investigates the fecal and tumor microbiome as potential biomarkers of tumor response to neoadjuvant immunotherapy in combination with chemoradiation. We performed 16S rRNA amplicon sequencing on fecal and tumor samples, as well as fecal metabolomics, on biosamples collected from patients with resectable esophageal or gastroesophageal junction carcinoma before and during treatment.

pmc-11554423.title: An Immunohistochemical Study on the Role of CD83+ Dendritic Cells (DCs) in Malignant and Benign Lesions of the Human Cervix
pmc-11554423.creator: Kalpana Ramachandran
pmc-11554423.description: BackgroundDendritic cells (DCs) are a group of cells that mainly function as antigen-presenting cells in the human body. Proper knowledge and understanding of such cells in the human cervix would be beneficial for understanding the role of CD83+ cells in benign and malignant lesions of the cervix.Materials and methodsThis retrospective study was performed on cervical specimens.

pmc-11556991.title: Prepatellar bursa mucosa: An unreported postoperative complication of patellar fracture
pmc-11556991.creator: Fukun Lin, Jihang Yao, Yiming Liu, Baochang Qi
pmc-11556991.description: Background:Patellar fracture is a common injury caused by overstrain of the extensor mechanism or a direct trauma to the knee. The most common complications after patellar fracture are nonunion, infection, post-traumatic arthritis, joint fibrosis, symptomatic hardware, and extensor mechanism failure.

pmc-11585559.title: Diversity of bacteria within the human gut and its contribution to the functional unity of holobionts
pmc-11585559.creator: Eugene Rosenberg
pmc-11585559.description: The composition of bacteria in the human colon has been a subject of interest since the beginning of microbiology. With the development of methods for culturing strict anaerobic bacteria under multiple culture conditions, it was shown the gut contained more than 400 bacterial species and different people harbor different abundant species.

pmc-11688849.title: “YOU HAVE TO USE YOUR IMAGINATION”: NURSING HOME PROVIDER MODIFICATIONS TO IMPLEMENTING THE IPPI
pmc-11688849.creator: Miranda Kunkel, Nahida Akter, Kamryn Kasler, Cassie Keiser, Molly Noble, Alexis Talmage, Kimberly Van Haitsma, Katherine Abbott
pmc-11688849.description: Understanding modification motive can help improve intervention protocols and future implementation efforts. The core components of the IPPI that should not be modified include that staff approach one-to-one resident interactions with a positive intent, use good communication skills, and base interactions on a preferred activity of the resident living with dementia.

pmc-12505651.title: Lupus nephritis in Africa: a systematic review of case reports and case series
pmc-12505651.creator: Mohamed Jayte, Abdifitah Abdullahi Mohamed, Abdifatah Karshe, Awil Abdulkadir Abdi, Hanan Asad Hassan
pmc-12505651.description: BackgroundLupus nephritis remains a severe manifestation of systemic lupus erythematosus across African populations, where diagnostic and therapeutic challenges significantly impact patient outcomes. This systematic review examines the clinical spectrum and management realities of this condition in African settings.MethodsFollowing PRISMA guidelines, we identified seven qualifying studies after screening 662 records from major databases.

pmc-12581866.title: Regression Discontinuity Designs in Epidemiology: A Practical Guide
pmc-12581866.creator: Aidan G O’Keeffe, Irene Petersen
pmc-12581866.description: Quasi-experimental approaches are used routinely in clinical epidemiological research to enable causal treatment/intervention effect estimation from observational data. One such approach is the regression discontinuity design (RDD): a method to estimate a causal effect in situations when a treatment or intervention is assigned to individuals according to an externally defined decision rule, based on a continuous, individual-level “assignment variable”.

pmc-13133992.title: Structures of variants of Escherichia coli flavodiiron-type nitric oxide reductase reveal changes in the di-iron site
pmc-13133992.creator: Patrícia T. Borges, Filipe Folgosa, Maria C. Martins, Guillaume Gotthard, Peter van der Linden, Philippe Carpentier, Miguel Teixeira, Carlos Frazão, Célia V. Romão
pmc-13133992.description: Flavodiiron proteins (FDPs) are di-iron enzymes that reduce NO and/or O2 with distinct substrate selectivity. We have produced E. coli FDP variants targeting second coordination-sphere residues and determined their structures. Although the kinetics remained unchanged, the E. coli FDP S262Y variant showed X-ray radiation-induced photoreduction, suggesting increased structural sensitivity without altered selectivity.

pmc-13216798.title: Potential for misclassification of community-acquired respiratory virus infections as healthcare-associated respiratory virus infections at a pediatric healthcare system
pmc-13216798.creator: Zachary M. Most, Trish M. Perl, Michael Sebert
pmc-13216798.description: During a period of universal admission respiratory virus testing, many events (5%–14%) that might have been classified as healthcare-associated respiratory viral infections (HARVI) during routine operations were found to be community-acquired. These findings emphasize unique challenges for HARVI surveillance and the impact that testing strategies have on reported rates.

pmc-13429758.title: Disparities in exclusive breastfeeding by current maternal employment status in Peru, 2005–2023: a cross-sectional analysis of ENDES data
pmc-13429758.creator: Lily Mabel Portal-Valqui, Kevin Cusma-Regalado, Jhofree Einstein Briceño-Chavez, Juan Carlos Bustamante-Rodríguez, Jhosmer Ballena-Caicedo, Fiorella E. Zuzunaga-Montoya, Víctor Juan Vera-Ponce
pmc-13429758.description: IntroductionExclusive breastfeeding (EBF) improves child survival and maternal health, but structural and employment-related conditions may affect its continuity. Evidence from Peru on EBF disparities by current maternal employment status remains limited.ObjectiveTo estimate descriptive disparities in EBF prevalence by current maternal employment status and describe their temporal and territorial patterns in Peru from 2005 to 2023.

pmc-13550825.title: Health Information-Seeking Behaviors Among Patients with Autoimmune Rheumatic Diseases: A Qualitative Study Guided by the S-O-R Theory
pmc-13550825.creator: Beisha Zhu, Lu Yang, Minjie Liu, Huan Jin, Yulan Xu, Shan Fang, Hui Hu
pmc-13550825.description: ObjectiveAutoimmune rheumatic diseases (ARDs) require long-term self-management, making health information-seeking behavior (HISB) essential. Prior studies have largely relied on surveys that identified isolated correlates of HISB without clarifying the underlying mechanisms. This exploratory study used the Stimulus-Organism-Response (S-O-R) framework to qualitatively investigate HISB among patients with ARDs, providing theory-informed process-oriented insights into information-seeking behavior in this population.

For the purposes of this chapter— (1) The term “depletion” or “depleted” means any case in which— (A) the Secretary, after consultation with the Marine Mammal Commission and the Committee of Scientific Advisors on Marine Mammals established under subchapter III of this chapter.
